exposure: supervised concurrent exercise-training program during pregnancy (60-min, 3 days/week, aerobic and strength training from 17th gestational week until birth)
cohort: One hundred and fifty-nine Caucasian pregnant women from the GESTAFIT project, with an average age of 33.1 years and BMI of 24.8 kg/m^2, participated in the study.
finding: A supervised concurrent exercise program during pregnancy increased placental and neonatal weight, increased the duration of the first stage of labor, and decreased the duration of the second stage of labor.
mod_finding: No differences were found between the exercise and control groups regarding type of birth.
